skill.summary: Simplified man pages from tldr-pages. Use this to quickly understand CLI tools.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the tldr skill version 1.0.0.
- Provides concise, community-driven man pages via the tldr-pages project.
- Includes usage instructions for viewing command examples, updating the cache, and listing available pages.
- Recommends using tldr over traditional manuals for quick CLI reference.
